from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from difflib import unified_diff
import json

root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
source = root / 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md'
raw = source.read_bytes()
expected = '17cc9de7d7d8e93b4946fe2f5930181460de70e683d2b837012814dd82a68248'
assert sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected, 'Captured README changed. Reassess placement against the new capture.'
lines = raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True)
start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == '## Misc')
end = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith('## '))
neighbors = [i for i in range(start + 1, end) if lines[i].startswith('- ') and 'sqliteproof' in lines[i]]
assert len(neighbors) == 1
assert any('Send in a pull request' in line for line in lines)
url = 'https://globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev/'
assert all(url not in line for line in lines)
entry = f'- [SQLite Statement Diagnostic]({url}) - Free guide and downloadable diagnostic for checking SQLite statement preparation and query results with synthetic or anonymized SQL. Built and maintained by autonomous AI agents.\n'
position = neighbors[0] + 1
candidate = lines[:position] + [entry] + lines[position:]
assert ''.join(candidate[:position] + candidate[position + 1:]).encode('utf-8') == raw
patch = ''.join(unified_diff(lines, candidate, fromfile='a/README.md', tofile='b/README.md'))
assert [line for line in patch.splitlines() if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++')] == ['+' + entry.rstrip('\n')]
assert not any(line.startswith('-') and not line.startswith('---') for line in patch.splitlines())
record = {'status': 'PRIVATE_DRAFT', 'repository': 'https://github.com/planetopendata/awesome-sqlite', 'captured_readme_sha256': expected, 'placement': 'Misc, immediately after sqliteproof', 'entry': entry.rstrip(), 'submission_basis': 'Captured README explicitly invites pull requests. Misc includes diagnostic tools. Maintainer acceptance and any specific AI contribution rules remain unverified.', 'operator_steps': ['Check current contribution rules and the live destination before deciding whether to submit.', 'If authorized and the rules support the disclosed entry, rebase this one-line addition against the current README and use the approved operator account to open a pull request.', 'Record submission and merge separately. Track eligible attributed inquiries and verified settlements separately.'], 'pull_request_title': 'Add SQLite Statement Diagnostic to Misc', 'pull_request_body': 'Adds a free SQLite statement-preparation guide and downloadable diagnostic. It uses synthetic or anonymized SQL and includes a worked example. Autonomous AI agents built and maintain it and drafted this entry.', 'patch_sha256': sha256(patch.encode()).hexdigest()}
patch_path = root / 'director-referral-candidate.diff'
record_path = root / 'director-referral-candidate.json'
patch_path.write_text(patch, encoding='utf-8')
record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert sha256(patch_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == json.loads(record_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['patch_sha256']
print(json.dumps({'verified_single_addition': True, 'handoff': str(record_path), 'patch': str(patch_path)}))
